image-object-counter/counter/empty: Upload an image to start counting
image-object-counter/counter/hint: Click the image to mark an object
image-object-counter/counter/view_hint: Drag to pan, scroll or use the zoom buttons to zoom in
image-object-counter/features/accurate: Red dots stay exactly where you click, so every object can be checked one by one
image-object-counter/features/full_image: The whole image is shown at once, scaled to fit the view
image-object-counter/features/mistakes: Undo the last dot, or clear all dots and start over
image-object-counter/features/privacy: Everything runs in your browser, images are never uploaded
image-object-counter/features/zoom: Zoom and pan to hit small or dense objects precisely
image-object-counter/how_to_use/step1: Upload, drop, or paste the image you want to count
image-object-counter/how_to_use/step2: Zoom in with the mouse wheel or the +/- buttons, then drag to move around
image-object-counter/how_to_use/step3: Click each object once to drop a red dot on it
image-object-counter/how_to_use/step4: Read the count in the top right, and use Undo or Clear All to fix mistakes
image-object-counter/note: Count objects in an image by hand: click each item to drop a red dot, watch the running total, undo mistakes, and zoom into dense areas. Everything runs in your browser.
image-object-counter/tags: image object counter, count objects in image, manual counting, tally counter, mark and count, image annotation
image-object-counter/upload/note: If you upload several images, the last one is used for counting
